population: All F1 (12 starts) and F2 (6 actual starts from roster of 12), all four pre-matched pairs, no replacement. Report remaining roster unstarted.
comparison: Pair on registered control ID, check per-tick goal is identical; measure RMS absolute position and angle and initial-state-relative change error during transition (0..1s), known X/Z movement (1..2.9s), common first stopped second (2.9..3.9s). Report complete run and first dwell inside original 4 mm/2 deg for a continuous second; retain native stops and refusals.
decision: Archive can characterize X/Z ramp and parking only. A later dynamic test must cover curve, orientation, intent revision and moving STOP. No native promotion by terminal hold.
